title: Yezdi Scrambler Rebel Red (Pro Spec)
description: The Yezdi Motorcycles Yezdi Scrambler Rebel Red (Pro Spec) is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration, positioned in the Performance Cruiser segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
